auth.custodyNote: No fees. Your money never passes through the app.
auth.finishingSignInBody: Connecting your account. This only takes a moment.

auth.codeExpired: Code expired — request a new one.
auth.usernameInvalid: Invalid username — min 4 chars: letters, numbers, _ or -.
auth.passwordPwned: That password has leaked online — pick another one.
auth.nameRequired: Enter your first and last name.
auth.emailTaken: That email is already in use.
auth.resetDesc: Enter your account email — a code will be sent there. No email on the account? Contact your president or support.
auth.resetCodeDesc: Code sent to {{email}}. Pick a new password.
auth.googleFailed: Google sign-in didn't complete. Try again or use your password.
auth.newDeviceDesc: New device detected — a code was sent to your email.

lockCycle.detail_other: The rotation is ready for {{count}} members.

unifiedChooser.title: What do you want to organize?
unifiedChooser.subtitle: One place for a one-time contribution or the full rhythm of a njangi.
unifiedChooser.contributionBody: Create one link for a funeral, wedding, school need, gift, trip, or any shared purpose.
unifiedChooser.njangiBody: Organize members, recurring contributions, meetings, and the rotation.
unifiedChooser.joinBody: Open a WhatsApp invitation or enter its code.
unifiedChooser.safety: OnCotise keeps the shared record. Mobile Money and cash stay between people.

prototype.title: Every reason people come together
prototype.subtitle: Contribution groups and njangis stay in one action-first stream.

entry.title: Bring people together
entry.subtitle: Begin a new collective, or arrive with an invitation from people you trust.
entry.createBody: Shape the rhythm and invite your people.
entry.joinBody: Paste the WhatsApp message or enter its code.
entry.safety: Njangi keeps the shared record. Money stays between members.

wizard.title: Create a njangi
wizard.nameTitle: What will your people call it?
wizard.nameBody: Choose a familiar name people will recognise in WhatsApp and in the shared record.
wizard.rhythmBody: Pick the cadence your group already understands. You can refine the meeting time later.
wizard.contributionBody: This is the amount expected from each member at every round. The app only keeps the shared record.
wizard.handoverNote: An expectation between members. Njangi never receives or holds it.
wizard.modeBody: Make the real-world path explicit so every member knows who receives from whom.
wizard.modeViaTreasurerDesc: Members hand their contribution to the treasurer, who hands the pot to the round's beneficiary.
wizard.modeDirectDesc: Each member hands their contribution directly to the round's beneficiary.
wizard.modeCustodyNote: Either way, money moves between people by MoMo, Orange Money or cash. It never passes through Njangi.
wizard.charterBody: Choose your real role, then read the compact agreement your members will see.
wizard.roleHint: The person creating the group is often the treasurer—choose your real role. Roles can be completed during group setup.
wizard.roleTreasurerDesc: I will record collections and handovers.
wizard.rolePresidentDesc: I will guide membership and group decisions.
wizard.inviteHint: Send the code in your njangi's WhatsApp group. You can also add members yourself.
wizard.successBody: {{name}} is ready for its people. Invite them now; the first cycle still starts only when the group is ready.

detail.addMemberTitle: Add a member without a smartphone
detail.addMemberDesc: For members who don't have the app: you keep the ledger for them. If they sign up later with this number, they get their place and history back.
detail.setupBanner_one: {{count}} member added — start the cycle once everyone has joined.
detail.setupBanner_other: {{count}} members added — start the cycle once everyone has joined.
detail.rotationPlaceholder: Cycle start, rotation order and rounds will appear here very soon.
detail.addByUsernameDesc: For members who already have the app: enter their exact username — they'll be notified.
detail.noPresidentBanner: This group has no president yet — name one below to be able to start the cycle.
detail.alreadyMemberError: This person is already a member of this group.

handover.title: Treasurer handover
handover.choose: Choose an active member who uses the app.
handover.pendingContributions_one: {{count}} pending contribution will now be due to {{name}}.
handover.pendingContributions_other: {{count}} pending contributions will now be due to {{name}}.
handover.pendingPayouts_one: {{count}} pending pot handover will be recorded by {{name}}.
handover.pendingPayouts_other: {{count}} pending pot handovers will be recorded by {{name}}.
handover.claimsStay_one: {{count}} declaration already made to {{name}} stays with that person.
handover.claimsStay_other: {{count}} declarations already made to {{name}} stay with that person.
handover.historyStays: All confirmed history keeps its original parties.
handover.custody: Cash with {{name}} — the app holds no funds

invite.title: Invite members
invite.whatsappMessage: Join our njangi (tontine) "{{groupName}}" on the Njangi app. Invite code: {{code}}. In the app, tap "I have a code" and enter it. The app replaces the notebook — the money never passes through it.

join.title: Join your people
join.desc: Enter the 6-character code, or paste the full invitation you received on WhatsApp.
join.invalid: That invitation could not be found. Check the message you received.
join.pasteHint: You can paste the whole WhatsApp message here.
join.previewSafety: This preview confirms the group only. Its private member list and records stay hidden.
join.full: This group has reached its member limit.
join.unavailable: An officer needs to help you rejoin this group.
join.couldNotJoin: The request could not be sent. Check your connection and try again.
join.requestSentBody: A president or treasurer will approve your request. We’ll let you know when the circle opens.
join.waitingStatus: Waiting for an officer to approve

cycle.title: Start the cycle
cycle.subtitle: Arrange the collection order, then lock it. Once locked it's fixed and visible to everyone.
cycle.presidentOnly: Only the president can lock and start the cycle.
cycle.confirmBody: The order will be fixed and visible to all members. It can't be re-drafted afterwards — later changes only happen through a turn swap by the president.
cycle.lockedToast: Cycle started — the order is locked ✓
cycle.setupReady: Everyone's in? Arrange the rotation order and start the cycle.
cycle.setupWaiting: The president will start the cycle once everyone has joined.

card.betweenLine: Cycle finished · plan the next draw

tab.emptyBody: Create your own, or join your association’s with an invite code.

round.title: Round {{n}}
round.notOpenBody: Contributions for this round open at the start of the period. You will be notified.
round.noObligation: No contribution expected from you this round.

pay.title: Contribute · Round {{n}} · {{amount}}
pay.cashBody: Bring {{amount}} to the next meeting. {{name}} will tick your name in Meeting Mode.
pay.cashClaimCta: I already handed over the cash → Declare
pay.custodyNote: The money goes directly from your account to {{name}}'s. The app never touches your money.
pay.custodyNoteNeutral: Money moves directly between members. The app never holds your money.

unavailable.missingPhone: No number on file for {{name}} — pay cash at the meeting.

pay.banner: The *126# / #150# menus can change. Verify each step against what your phone shows.
pay.amountPrefilled: Prefilled: remaining to contribute. Declare what you actually sent.
pay.proofNote: {{name}}'s confirmation is what makes the payment official — not the proof.
pay.overWarning: Amount above what remains expected — declare what you actually sent.
pay.invalidAmount: Enter a valid amount in F.
pay.photoHint: Screenshot of the SMS or a photo of the receipt — optional but recommended.
pay.cameraDenied: Camera access denied — allow it in Settings.

inbox.title: To confirm ({{count}})
inbox.claimedByPayee: {{name}} recorded your payment — confirm or flag it
inbox.emptyHint: When a member declares a payment that involves you, it shows up here.

payment.confirmGuard: Are you sure? You confirm you received {{amount}} from {{name}}. This confirmation remains in history; only a reasoned president correction can make the amount due again.
payment.onBehalfNote: attested by the president for a member without the app
payment.disputeNotePlaceholder: e.g. nothing arrived on my account
payment.disputed: Dispute opened — the group is notified
payment.cancelGuard: Withdraw your declaration? Your contribution goes back to « pending » and must be declared again.
payment.withdrawFromDispute: I withdraw my declaration (closes the dispute)
payment.disputeAuto: Opened automatically — payment not confirmed in time
payment.proofImageNote: Proof helps verify — confirmation is what makes the payment official.
payment.correctBody: It will remain visible in history as a president correction. No trace will be deleted.
payment.correctConfirmationPreserved: The original confirmation remains visible and a new obligation will be created.
payment.correctReasonPlaceholder: e.g. Duplicate recorded during the meeting
payment.correctionHistoryNote: The original confirmation and this decision remain in the ledger.

status.pendingBody: Nobody has recorded this payment yet.
status.needsYouBody: Confirm this entry if it is right, or challenge it if it is not.
status.waitingBody: The entry becomes official once {{name}} confirms it.
status.disputedYoursBody: You can withdraw your declaration, or settle it with {{name}} at the meeting.
status.disputedBody: {{payer}} and {{payee}} must settle this — usually at the meeting. The president can correct a confirmed error.
status.confirmedBody: Both sides agreed. Nothing more to do here.
status.cancelledBody: This declaration was withdrawn and no longer counts.

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Your identity, preferences, and place in the circle.
profile.appearanceDescription: System follows this device. Light and Dark stay as local overrides.

payout.claimed: Handover declared — the other party must confirm ✓
